function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
Below is a concise guide to the most important aspects of **traffic law in Texas**—the rules you’ll encounter when driving, riding a motorcycle, bicycling, or operating other vehicles within state borders. --- ### 1️⃣ Core Legal Framework | Source | Key Points | |--------|------------| | **Texas Transportation Code (TTC)** | Governs all motor vehicle operations – licensing, registration, insurance, driver conduct, road safety standards, and enforcement procedures. | | **Texas Vehicle Code** | Covers non‑motorized transportation regulations (bicycles, scooters). | | **State Statutes & Local Ordinances** | May impose additional restrictions (e.g., school zone speed limits, local parking ordinances). | > *Tip:* For the full text, visit the official [Texas Legislature Online](https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/) site. --- ### 2️⃣ Common Traffic Violations & Penalties | Violation | Typical Fine | Points Added | Possible Consequences | |-----------|--------------|-------------|-----------------------| | Speeding over limit | $50–$200 per mph above limit | 0–5 pts | License suspension after cumulative points | | Running red lights / stop signs | $100–$300 | 3 pts | Potential license revocation | | Driving under influence (DUI) | $500+ + possible jail time | 10 pts | License revocation, mandatory alcohol treatment | | Seat belt failure | $25–$75 | 1 pt | Repeat offenders face higher fines | | Texting while driving | $150–$250 | 3 pts | Mandatory education program | | Failure to yield at railroad crossing | $200–$400 | 3 pts | Additional penalty if collision occurs | | Reckless driving | $600–$800 | 8 pts | Jail up to 30 days, license revocation | | Operating without valid insurance | $200–$700 | 3 pts | Suspension of registration/driver’s license | *Points System*: Texas uses a “point” system where each violation adds points to your record. Accumulating 12 points in two years leads to a provisional license suspension. After four years with zero points, you may qualify for a reduced fine schedule. --- ### 3️⃣ Driver Licensing Essentials | Requirement | Details | |-------------|---------| | Minimum age | 18 yrs for a regular driver's license; 15½ yrs for a learner permit (with parental consent). | | Vision test | Must meet minimum visual acuity requirements. | | Knowledge exam | Written test covering TTC provisions. | | Road‑test | Practical driving assessment. | | Insurance proof | Proof of liability coverage required before issuance. | | Renewal | Every 4 years; renew online via TXDMV portal. | > *Note:* Commercial drivers require separate endorsements (CDL). --- ### 4️⃣ Special Rules for Motorcycles & Bicyclists | Category | Specific Law | |----------|---------------| | Motorcycle riders | Must wear helmet (unless exempted); seat belts not applicable. | | Bicycle lanes | Cyclists have right-of-way in designated bike lanes unless otherwise posted. | | Pedestrian rights | Drivers must yield to pedestrians in crosswalks even if signal shows green. | --- ### 5️⃣ Enforcement Resources | Resource | What It Offers | |----------|----------------| | **TxDOT Highway Patrol** | Statewide highway patrol enforcing federal and state traffic laws. | | **Local Police Departments** | City-level enforcement, especially in urban areas. | | **Department of Public Safety (DPS)** | Handles DUI checkpoints, roadside inspections, and maintains the statewide point database. | | **Online Services** | • Check ticket status
• Pay fines
• Request court appearances | Website: https://www.dps.state.tx.us/ --- ### 6️⃣ Quick Reference Cheat Sheet | Situation | Action Needed | |-----------|---------------| | You’re pulled over for speeding | Show ID, registration, proof of insurance; remain calm. | | Ticket issued but you believe it’s wrong | File a contest through DPS online portal or request a hearing. | | Accident involving injury | Call emergency services immediately; exchange contact details. | | Lost license | Apply for replacement via DPS website; pay fee ($20). | | Need to add a new address | Update DMV records online; update email notifications. | --- #### 📚 Further Reading & Official Sources - **Texas Transportation Code:** https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/?link=TTCCODE.htm - **TXDMV Driver's Handbook:** https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/documents/TX%20Driver%27s%20Handbook.pdf - **Traffic Laws FAQ (Texan Government):** https://gov.texas.gov/topics/legal/traffic-laws-faq Feel free to ask if you’d like deeper dives into any specific area—such as how to appeal a citation, detailed DUI guidelines, or commercial driver regulations!
